Allowed origins: `http://localhost:4200` (exact) plus any `*.pages.dev` and `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

**Location:** `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `cors()` middleware's `origin` callback (lines ~20-29, right after `app.use('*', logger())`).

To add a new custom domain, add a check inside that same callback, e.g.:
```ts
if (origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com') return origin;
```
or extend the `||` chain. Since Hono matches array entries as exact strings only, wildcard/custom domains must go through this function — editing an array won't work. See `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md#4-cors` for background.
